title: Guest Buyer Signs In Elsewhere
h1: Guest-mode buyer on lucasmrichtest, then reinis-test-store: account sign-in and Shop Pay checkout
subtitle: Frames from the Playwright trace of spec 4, attempt 8, run from Erin's machine against production on 2026-09-30. Spec 3 in full, then the same browser signs in to reinis-test-store's customer account through Sign in with Shop and opens a cart permalink there. Frames are unedited screencast stills of the main window, except the two popup frames (email code, phone code) and the two part C frames, which are test screenshots taken by the spec, since the screencast does not record the popup.
store: lucasmrichtest.myshopify.com · shop 60529737962 (checkout on polly-lucas.myshopify.com), then reinis-test-store.myshopify.com · shop 8013840406
override: EXP_OVERRIDES e_ac6fae2281b0e908985ecf9c8069ba5d=treatment (header sent for the whole run)

moments.name: pay-checkout-landed
moments.title: A. Guest mode: straight into Pay checkout
moments.body: Benchmark alias {email} submitted at the Shop Pay sign-in, no phone step. Shipping phone 4385559156 is typed into the address form later; it is never verified in part A.

moments.name: order-confirmed
moments.title: A. Order confirmed on lucasmrichtest
moments.body: Thank-you page, confirmation {order}. The buyer now has a guest-mode Shop account with an unverified phone on the shipping address.

moments.name: account-login-page
moments.title: B. reinis-test-store customer account sign-in
moments.body: /account/login redirects through Sign in with Shop to shopify.com/authentication/8013840406/login. The spec clicks Continue with Shop, which opens a popup at shop.app/accounts/login with authentication_level=email.

moments.name: email-code
moments.title: B. Email code in the Shop sign-in popup
moments.body: The popup at shop.app/accounts/login after the email was submitted: "Verify your email" with the six-box code field. The spec confirmed no phone number field existed at this point, then entered 000000.

moments.name: phone-step-at-sign-in
moments.title: B. Shop then asks for a phone code
moments.body: "Verify your phone, enter code sent to +1 ••• ••• •156": the part A shipping phone 4385559156, never verified before this point. This is the intended behaviour (confirmed 2026-09-30), so the spec now requires this step, enters 000000, and Shop accepts it.

moments.name: signed-in
moments.title: B. Signed in to the customer account
moments.body: Popup closed by itself through shop.app/pay/session/create_and_redirect and /customer_authentication/sso_hint. URL is shopify.com/8013840406/account with the Orders heading.

moments.name: reinis-cart-permalink
moments.title: C. Cart permalink lands in Pay checkout
moments.body: Screenshot taken as soon as the URL reached shop.app/checkout/8013840406/cn/…/shoppay, so it already shows Pay checkout loading. The redirect chain is in the request table below: /cart/51304521662486:1, silent OAuth on shopify.com/authentication, /customer_authentication/callback, /cart?shop_sign_in=true, shop.app/pay/session/create_and_redirect, then /shoppay. No merchant checkout page, no Shop Pay button, no email, no phone, no SMS code.

moments.name: reinis-pay-checkout
moments.title: C. Pay checkout on reinis-test-store, fully vaulted
moments.body: {email} in the header, Alice Smith address from part A, card from part A, Pay now enabled. The spec asserts no email field, phone field, email code or phone code is present, and that the same email is vaulted.

proves: A buyer created through guest mode can sign in to a different store's customer account through Sign in with Shop. Shop asks for an email code and then an SMS code to the part A shipping phone, which verifies that phone.
After that sign-in, opening a cart permalink on reinis-test-store lands the buyer directly in Shop Pay checkout with address and card vaulted, and no further email, phone or SMS step.
All three parts run in one browser, so this is one person continuing, not a competing browser. Every expectation is a hard assertion and the run passed.
caveats: That the phone code in part B is what lets part C skip verification is the working explanation, not something this run shows on its own. The popup cannot be completed without the phone code, so a run without it is not possible through this path.

The direct jump from the cart permalink into Pay checkout happens because the customer account session is present. Confirmed as the intended experience on 2026-09-30; runs 4 to 6 of this spec had recorded it as a deviation.
The guest-mode override header is sent for the whole run, including parts B and C. An existing buyer with an order is outside the experiment's gates, so it should not change them.
Full run {duration} s. Store lucasmrichtest is on pod 233 (framework warns E2E shops must be on pod 21), so this spec stays local.
Benchmark identity: fixed email code and simulated SMS; one run, one browser.
